title: ED-DiT: Physics-Guided Diffusion Pretraining for Transferable Molecular Representations from Electron Density
abstract: arXiv:2608.03260v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pretraining has shown strong potential for learning transferable representations, yet it remains underexplored for electron-density-based molecular learning. Electron density provides a continuous three-dimensional description of molecular electronic structure, capturing both local spatial patterns and global physical quantities. This raises a key question: can electron-density fields be used for self-supervised pretraining to learn a shared representation that transfers across diverse electronic-structure-related tasks? We propose ED-DiT, a physics-guided Diffusion Transformer for self-supervised pretraining on electron-density point clouds. ED-DiT learns reusable representations by reconstructing corrupted and partially masked log-density fields across diffusion noise levels. translated_title: ED-DiT：基于电子密度的物理引导扩散预训练，用于可迁移的分子表示
translated_abstract: 预训练在学习可迁移表示方面已展现出强大潜力，但其在基于电子密度的分子学习中仍未得到充分探索。电子密度为分子电子结构提供了连续的三维描述，既捕捉局部空间模式，也蕴含全局物理量。这引出了一个关键问题：电子密度场能否用于自监督预训练，以学习一种可在多种电子结构相关任务间迁移的共享表示？我们提出了 ED-DiT，一种物理引导的扩散 Transformer，用于在电子密度点云上进行自监督预训练。ED-DiT 通过在不同扩散噪声水平下重建被破坏和部分掩码的对数密度场来学习可复用的表示，并进一步引入电子数一致性约束以保持总电子质量。预训练得到的编码器可以适配到性质预测……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了 ED-DiT——一种物理引导的扩散 Transformer，通过在不同噪声水平下重建被破坏与掩码的对数电子密度场，并结合电子数一致性约束进行自监督预训练，学习可跨多种电子结构相关任务迁移的分子表示。
en_tdlr: ED-DiT is a physics-guided Diffusion Transformer that learns transferable molecular representations via self-supervised pretraining on electron-density point clouds, reconstructing corrupted and masked log-density fields across noise levels while enforcing an electron-number consistency constraint.
